message.content:
Yes—if you’re experiencing a noise issue in Atlanta, you can file a complaint with the city’s local authorities. In the United States, “local council” usually refers to the city council, but noise complaints are typically handled by the city’s police department or code‑enforcement office rather than the council itself. Here’s how you can report it: | Step | What to Do | Where to Go / Who to Contact | |------|------------|------------------------------| | **1. Identify the source** | Determine whether the noise is coming from a residential, commercial, or public property. | — | | **2. Check the city’s noise ordinance** | Atlanta’s noise ordinance (Title 10, Chapter 1 of the Atlanta Municipal Code) sets limits on permissible noise levels and times. | City of Atlanta website – Municipal Code section 10‑1 | | **3. File a complaint** | • **Online**: Use the City of Atlanta’s “311” portal or the “City of Atlanta Online Services” portal.
• **Phone**: Call 311 (or 404‑656‑3111 if you’re outside the city).
• **In person**: Visit the City Hall or the local police precinct. | City of Atlanta 311 portal: https://www.atlantaga.gov/311
Police Department: 404‑656‑3111 | | **4. Provide details** | • Date & time of the noise.
• Exact location (address or intersection).
• Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs).
• Any evidence (photos, videos, audio recordings). | — | | **5. Follow up** | After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. You can track the status via the 311 portal or by calling 311. | — | ### Quick Tips - **Construction noise** is allowed between 7 a.m. and 10 p.m. on weekdays, and 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. on weekends. - **Music or parties** must be kept below 70 dB during the day and 60 dB at night. - **Animals**: Dogs barking more than 3 minutes per hour may be reported. - **Persistent offenders**: If the same source repeatedly violates the ordinance, the city can issue citations or fines. ### Contact Information | Agency | Phone | Email | Address | |--------|-------|-------|---------| | City of Atlanta Police Department | 404‑656‑3111 | [police@atlantaga.gov](mailto:police@atlantaga.gov) | 1000 Peachtree Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30309 | | City of Atlanta 311 Service | 311 (or 404‑656‑3111) | — | — | | City Hall (for in‑person visits) | 404‑656‑3111 | — | 1000 Peachtree Street NW, Atlanta, GA 30309 | If you’re outside the city limits, you can still call 311; the dispatcher will route your call to the appropriate jurisdiction. --- **Bottom line:** Yes, you can report a noise complaint in Atlanta. Use the 311 system (online or phone), provide as much detail as possible, and the city’s police or code‑enforcement team will investigate.
